newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai stock exchange closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai stock exchange closed for holiday.

text.p: The Shanghai Stock Exchange was closed on Monday because of a National Day holiday, an exchange official said. Trading will resume on Thursday, he said.
On Friday, the last trading day, Shanghai's A share index ended up 22.326 points or 2.49 percent at 918.946 points and the B share index gained 0.241 points or 0.50 percent to 48.903 points.
